desc.en: Live in a university res on or near campus
desc.zu: Uhlala e-res yenyuvesi ekhampasi noma eduze

desc.en: Rent from a private landlord in {area}
Travel to campus by taxi, bus or train
desc.zu: Uya ekhampasi ngetekisi, ibhasi noma isitimela

desc.en: Government bursary with a living allowance

rentNote.en: Rent is paid by NSFAS directly to an accredited provider. Check that your place is accredited.
rentNote.zu: Irenti ikhokhwa yi-NSFAS ngqo kumhlinzeki ogunyaziwe. Qinisekisa ukuthi indawo yakho igunyaziwe.

rentNote.en: Check your contract to see whether rent is paid directly or comes out of your stipend.
rentNote.zu: Bheka inkontileka yakho ukuthi irenti ikhokhwa ngqo noma iphuma emalini yakho.

desc.en: Family covers fees and sends money
desc.zu: Umndeni ukhokha izimali futhi uthumela imali

rentNote.en: Agree with your family who pays rent, and on which date, before term starts.
rentNote.zu: Vumelanani nomndeni ukuthi ubani okhokha irenti, nangaluphi usuku, ngaphambi kokuqala kwetemu.

rentNote.en: Put rent first in your budget. It is the bill that cannot wait.
rentNote.zu: Faka irenti kuqala ebhajethini yakho. Yisikweletu esingakwazi ukulinda.

desc.en: Your first time living in a city

text.en: A friend is ordering takeaways. Add yours for {amount}?
text.zu: Umngane uoda ukudla okuthathwayo. Ufaka okwakho ngo-{amount}?

text.en: New sneakers are on sale for {amount}. Buy them?
text.zu: Izicathulo ezintsha zidayiswa ngo-{amount}. Uyazithenga?

text.en: Sign up for a streaming subscription at {amount} a month?
text.zu: Ubhalisela ukubuka okubhaliselwayo ngo-{amount} ngenyanga?

text.en: Your data's low. Buy a social bundle for {amount}?
text.zu: Idatha yakho iphansi. Uthenga i-bundle yezokuxhumana ngo-{amount}?

text.en: Tickets for a campus concert: {amount}. Go?
text.zu: Amathikithi ekhonsathi yasekhampasi: u-{amount}. Uyahamba?

text.en: End of a long week. Takeaways for {amount}?
text.zu: Ukuphela kwesonto elide. Ukudla okuthathwayo ngo-{amount}?

text.en: Your first big tests. Your results depend on the choices you made in earlier weeks.
text.zu: Izivivinyo zakho zokuqala ezinkulu. Imiphumela yakho incike ezinqumweni ozenze emasontweni adlule.

label.en: Talked it through with a friend
No laptop and no lab time
label.zu: Ayikho i-laptop futhi asikho isikhathi segumbi lamakhompyutha

label.en: A team or society to lean on

text.en: Your first big tests. Your results depend on the choices you made in earlier weeks.
text.zu: Izivivinyo zakho zokuqala ezinkulu. Imiphumela yakho incike ezinqumweni ozenze emasontweni adlule.

text.en: Here's where your semester landed, and why it matters for second year.
text.zu: Nakhu lapho isemesta yakho igcine khona, nokuthi kubaluleke ngani onyakeni wesibili.

body.en: You passed both key modules. You're on track for second year, and you know where help is if things change.
body.zu: Uphase zombili izifundo ezibalulekile. Usendleleni eya onyakeni wesibili, futhi uyazi ukuthi usizo lukuphi uma izinto zishintsha.

body.en: One key module is below the pass mark. There's still time: exams carry a lot of weight, and coaches and advisors can help you plan a recovery.
body.zu: Isifundo esisodwa esibalulekile singaphansi kwamamaki okuphasa. Sisekhona isikhathi: izivivinyo zokugcina zinesisindo esikhulu, futhi abaqeqeshi nabeluleki bangakusiza uhlele ukubuyisela.

title.en: A tough start, and a chance to change it

body.en: Both key modules are below the pass mark. In real life this is the moment to act, not quit: see an advisor this week. Try playing again with different choices to see what changes.
body.zu: Zombili izifundo ezibalulekile zingaphansi kwamamaki okuphasa. Empilweni yangempela lesi yisikhathi sokuthatha isinyathelo, hhayi ukuyeka: bona umeluleki kuleli sonto. Zama ukudlala futhi ngezinqumo ezahlukene ubone ukuthi yini eshintshayo.

nsfas.en: NSFAS has required first-years to pass a minimum share of their registered credits (historically at least half) to stay funded. Failing key modules can cost you your funding. Confirm the current rule with NSFAS.
nsfas.zu: I-NSFAS ibidinga ukuthi abafundi bonyaka wokuqala baphase ingxenye ethile yamakhredithi ababhalisele wona (ngokomlando okungenani ingxenye) ukuze baqhubeke bexhaswa. Ukwehluleka ezifundweni ezibalulekile kungakulahlekisela ngomxhaso. Qinisekisa umthetho wamanje ne-NSFAS.

bursary.en: Most bursaries require you to pass a minimum of your modules or keep an average. Check your contract now, not after exams.
bursary.zu: Iningi lemixhaso lidinga ukuthi uphase inani elithile lezifundo noma ugcine isilinganiso. Hlola inkontileka yakho manje, hhayi emva kwezivivinyo.

family.en: Paying for repeated modules is expensive for a family. Passing key modules first time saves real money.
family.zu: Ukukhokhela izifundo eziphindwayo kubiza kakhulu emndenini. Ukuphasa izifundo ezibalulekile okokuqala konga imali yangempela.

self.en: Repeating modules costs you fees and time. Passing key modules first time protects your loan and savings.
self.zu: Ukuphinda izifundo kukubiza imali nesikhathi. Ukuphasa izifundo ezibalulekile okokuqala kuvikela imalimboleko nemali yakho olondoloze.

all.en: At {short}, failing key first-year modules like {mod1} and {mod2} can block progression to second-year modules that build on them.
all.zu: E-{short}, ukwehluleka ezifundweni ezibalulekile zonyaka wokuqala njenge-{mod1} ne-{mod2} kungavimba ukuqhubekela ezifundweni zonyaka wesibili ezakhela phezu kwazo.

text.en: Keep a buffer: set aside two weeks of food money from your first payment.
text.zu: Gcina imali eyisiphephelo: beka eceleni imali yokudla yamasonto amabili enkokhelweni yakho yokuqala.

text.en: Check your status on myNSFAS and save the NSFAS number: 08000 67327.
text.zu: Hlola isimo sakho ku-myNSFAS futhi ulondoloze inombolo ye-NSFAS: 08000 67327.

text.en: Save your bursary officer's email and number, and ask them for the payment dates.
text.zu: Londoloza i-imeyili nenombolo yesikhulu somxhaso wakho, futhi ubacele izinsuku zokukhokha.

text.en: Agree the exact payment date with whoever sends your money, and what happens if it's late.
text.zu: Vumelanani ngosuku oluqondile lokukhokha nalowo othumela imali yakho, nokuthi kuzokwenzekani uma yephuza.

text.en: Go to campus food support early, before food runs out, not after.
text.zu: Yiya osizweni lokudla lwasekhampasi kusenesikhathi, ngaphambi kokuthi ukudla kuphele, hhayi emva kwalokho.

text.en: Ask the SRC or financial aid office to follow up if your allowance is more than a week late.
text.zu: Cela i-SRC noma ihhovisi lezezimali lilandelele uma imali yakho yephuze ngaphezu kwesonto.

text.en: Tell your landlord early, in writing, if rent will be late.
text.zu: Tshela umnikazi wendlu kusenesikhathi, ngokubhala, uma irenti izophuza.

text.en: If you borrow, write down who and how much, and repay on payday.
text.zu: Uma uboleka, bhala phansi ukuthi ubani nokuthi malini, bese ubuyisela ngosuku lokuholela.

text.en: Don't skip meals to stretch money. Hunger costs you marks.
text.zu: Ungeqi ukudla ukuze welule imali. Indlala ikulahlekisela ngamamaki.

what.en: Register, then confirm your modules with a faculty advisor
what.zu: Bhalisa, bese uqinisekisa izifundo zakho nomeluleki wefakhalthi

what.en: Last chance to add or change modules. Sign up for first-year mentorship.
what.zu: Ithuba lokugcina lokwengeza noma ukushintsha izifundo. Bhalisela ukwelulekwa konyaka wokuqala.

what.en: First allowance. It may be late, so have your buffer and playbook ready.
what.zu: Imali yokuqala. Ingase yephuze, ngakho lungisa imali eyisiphephelo nohlelo lwakho.

what.en: First test series. Deadlines cluster here, so book a coach in week 4.
what.zu: Uchungechunge lokuqala lwezivivinyo. Izinsuku zokuhambisa ziqoqana lapha, ngakho bhukha umqeqeshi ngesonto lesi-4.

what.en: Any module under 50%? See your advisor that week.
what.zu: Ingabe kukhona isifundo esingaphansi kuka-50%? Bona umeluleki wakho ngalelo sonto.

offers.en: Help choosing the right modules, changing your curriculum, and making a plan if you fall behind.
offers.zu: Usizo ekukhetheni izifundo ezifanele, ekushintsheni uhlelo lwakho lwezifundo, nasekwenzeni uhlelo uma usala emuva.

reach.en: Each faculty has its own advisors. Ask at your faculty's student administration or find them on your faculty's page at up.ac.za.
reach.zu: Ifakhalthi ngayinye inabeluleki bayo. Buza ehhovisi labafundi lefakhalthi yakho noma ubathole ekhasini lefakhalthi yakho ku-up.ac.za.

offers.en: One-on-one help to plan your study time, prepare for tests and manage clashing deadlines.
offers.zu: Usizo lomuntu ngamunye lokuhlela isikhathi sakho sokufunda, ukulungiselela izivivinyo nokuphatha izinsuku zokuhambisa ezingqubuzanayo.

reach.en: Book through your faculty's student support or the Department of Student Affairs.
reach.zu: Bhukha ngosizo lwabafundi lwefakhalthi yakho noma uMnyango Wezindaba Zabafundi.

offers.en: Day houses give commuting students a community, study space and activities on campus. Library study spaces stay open after lectures.
offers.zu: Izindlu zabafundi abangahlali ekhampasi zinika abafundi abagibelayo umphakathi, indawo yokufunda nemisebenzi ekhampasi. Izindawo zokufunda emtapweni zihlala zivulekile emva kwezifundo.

reach.en: Ask Student Affairs about joining a day house. If you're on NSFAS, check your transport allowance on myNSFAS.
reach.zu: Buza kuMnyango Wezindaba Zabafundi ngokujoyina indlu yabafundi abangahlali ekhampasi. Uma use-NSFAS, hlola imali yakho yokugibela ku-myNSFAS.

offers.en: Free, confidential counselling, in person or online. You don't need to be in crisis to go.
offers.zu: Ukwelulekwa kwamahhala, okuyimfihlo, ngomuntu noma ku-inthanethi. Akudingeki ube senkingeni enkulu ukuze uye.

reach.en: Book through UP Student Affairs. If you're in crisis, call a free line any time:
reach.zu: Bhukha nge-UP Student Affairs. Uma usenkingeni, shayela inombolo yamahhala noma nini:

name.en: How monthly debit orders add up
name.zu: Indlela ama-debit order anyanga zonke anqwabelana ngayo

offers.en: Gym contracts, phone contracts and subscriptions all leave your account automatically. Add up every debit order before signing, and check the cancellation terms.
offers.zu: Izivumelwano zejimu, zocingo nokubhaliselwe konke kuphuma ku-akhawunti yakho ngokuzenzakalela. Hlanganisa wonke ama-debit order ngaphambi kokusayina, futhi uhlole imigomo yokukhansela.

reach.en: Your survival plan's budget shows what's left after fixed costs.
reach.zu: Ibhajethi yohlelo lwakho lokusinda ikhombisa okusalayo emva kwezindleko ezingaguquki.

name.en: Computer labs, Wi-Fi and device support

offers.en: Open computer labs, library computers and free campus Wi-Fi for students. Some universities also offer laptop loans or device support.
offers.zu: Amagumbi amakhompyutha avulekile, amakhompyutha omtapo ne-Wi-Fi yamahhala yasekhampasi yabafundi. Amanye amanyuvesi anikeza nokubolekwa kwama-laptop noma usizo lwamadivayisi.

reach.en: Use the open computer labs and library computers on Hatfield campus. Ask Student Affairs about device support (details still to be confirmed with UP).
reach.zu: Sebenzisa amagumbi amakhompyutha avulekile namakhompyutha omtapo ekhampasi yaseHatfield. Buza kuMnyango Wezindaba Zabafundi ngosizo lwamadivayisi (imininingwane isazoqinisekiswa ne-UP).

offers.en: There's no single right answer. Decide upfront what share of your money you can send each month, put it in your budget, and tell home when your money arrives so they can plan too.
offers.zu: Ayikho impendulo eyodwa efanele. Nquma kusenesikhathi ukuthi ingakanani ingxenye yemali yakho ongayithumela nyanga zonke, uyifake ebhajethini yakho, futhi utshele ekhaya uma imali yakho ifika ukuze nabo bahlele.

reach.en: Your survival plan includes a line for family support. Share it with home.
reach.zu: Uhlelo lwakho lokusinda lunomugqa wosizo lomndeni. Wabelane nekhaya.

offers.en: Food parcels, food vouchers and meal allowances for students who are struggling to afford food.
offers.zu: Amaphasela okudla, amavawusha okudla nemali yokudla yabafundi abangakwazi ukuthenga ukudla.

reach.en: Contact UP's Department of Student Affairs. Go early: you don't need to wait until you have nothing left.
reach.zu: Xhumana noMnyango Wezindaba Zabafundi we-UP. Hamba kusenesikhathi: akudingeki ulinde kuze kungabi nalutho.

offers.en: Free or low-cost, confidential health care: illness, contraception, pregnancy tests and sexual health.
offers.zu: Ukunakekelwa kwezempilo kwamahhala noma kwentengo ephansi, okuyimfihlo: ukugula, izivikelo zokukhulelwa, ukuhlolwa kokukhulelwa nempilo yezocansi.

reach.en: Walk in or book at the student health clinic on Hatfield campus.
reach.zu: Ngena noma ubhukhe emtholampilo wezempilo wabafundi ekhampasi yaseHatfield.

name.zu: Inombolo yosizo ye-Higher Health yamahora angu-24

offers.en: Free, confidential support for students, 24 hours a day, including mental health and gender-based violence.
offers.zu: Usizo lwamahhala, oluyimfihlo lwabafundi, amahora angu-24 ngosuku, kuhlanganise impilo yengqondo nodlame olusekelwe ebulilini.

offers.en: Prescribed textbooks are often kept on short-loan or reserve so you can use them without buying.
offers.zu: Izincwadi ezimisiwe zivame ukugcinwa ukuze zibolekwe okwesikhashana ukuze uzisebenzise ngaphandle kokuzithenga.

reach.en: Ask at the library help desk on Hatfield campus, or search the library catalogue.
reach.zu: Buza edeskini losizo lomtapo wolwazi ekhampasi yaseHatfield, noma useshe ikhathalogi.

offers.en: A senior student mentor who helps you settle in, find your way around and cope with the first semester.
offers.zu: Umeluleki ongumfundi omdala okusiza ukuthi uzinze, uthole indlela futhi ubhekane nesemesta yokuqala.

reach.en: Sign up at the start of the year through your faculty or the Department of Student Affairs.
reach.zu: Bhalisa ekuqaleni konyaka ngefakhalthi yakho noma ngoMnyango Wezindaba Zabafundi.

name.en: TuksSport clubs and UP student societies

offers.en: Teams, cultural, faith, academic and hobby societies: a cheap way to meet people and feel at home.
offers.zu: Amaqembu, izinhlangano zamasiko, zokholo, zemfundo nezokuzilibazisa: indlela eshibhile yokuhlangana nabantu nokuzizwa usekhaya.

reach.en: Find sports clubs through TuksSport and societies on Societies Day, or ask the SRC.
reach.zu: Thola amaqembu ezemidlalo nge-TuksSport nezinhlangano ngoSuku Lwezinhlangano, noma ubuze i-SRC.

offers.en: The SRC and the financial aid office help follow up on late or missing NSFAS payments and funding problems.
offers.zu: I-SRC nehhovisi losizo lwezimali basiza ukulandelela izinkokhelo ze-NSFAS ezephuzile noma ezingekho kanye nezinkinga zomxhaso.

reach.en: Visit the SRC office on Hatfield campus. Check your status on the myNSFAS portal and call the NSFAS contact centre.
reach.zu: Vakashela ihhovisi le-SRC ekhampasi yaseHatfield. Hlola isimo sakho kuphothali ye-myNSFAS futhi ushayele isikhungo sokuxhumana se-NSFAS.

name.en: Check a room before you pay

offers.en: Use your university's list of accredited off-campus accommodation. View the room in person, get a written lease, and confirm an agent's registration with the PPRA. Search the photos online, and never pay a deposit under pressure.
offers.zu: Sebenzisa uhlu lwenyuvesi yakho lwezindawo zokuhlala ezigunyaziwe ngaphandle kwekhampasi. Bona ikamelo ngamehlo, thola inkontileka ebhaliwe, futhi uqinisekise ukubhaliswa kwe-ejenti ne-PPRA. Sesha izithombe ku-inthanethi, futhi ungalokothi ukhokhe idiphozithi ngaphansi kwengcindezi.

reach.en: Ask UP's residence and accommodation office for the list of accredited private accommodation.
reach.zu: Cela uhlu lwezindawo zokuhlala ezizimele ezigunyaziwe ehhovisi lezindawo zokuhlala le-UP.

text.en: Your timetable has gaps and clashes, and you're not sure which modules {course} needs. The queue at faculty administration goes round the building.
text.zu: Uhlelo lwakho lwezifundo lunezikhala nokungqubuzana, futhi awuqiniseki ukuthi yiziphi izifundo ezidingwa yi-{course}. Ulayini ehhovisi lefakhalthi uzungeza isakhiwo.

text.en: You've just arrived in {city} and don't know anyone yet. Your timetable has gaps and clashes, and you're not sure which modules {course} needs. The queue at faculty administration goes round the building.
text.zu: Usanda kufika {city} futhi awukaze wazi muntu. Uhlelo lwakho lwezifundo lunezikhala nokungqubuzana, futhi awuqiniseki ukuthi yiziphi izifundo ezidingwa yi-{course}. Ulayini ehhovisi lefakhalthi uzungeza isakhiwo.

outcome.en: A second-year shows you the core modules. Mostly right, but they're on a different programme, so double-check one choice.
outcome.zu: Umfundi wonyaka wesibili ukukhombisa izifundo eziyinhloko. Kuningi okulungile, kodwa usohlelweni oluhlukile, ngakho hlola kabili esinye isinqumo.

lesson.en: Seniors are a great start. An advisor can confirm the details.
lesson.zu: Abafundi abadala bayisiqalo esihle. Umeluleki angaqinisekisa imininingwane.

outcome.en: You register, but later find one module isn't part of your programme. Swapping it costs you a week of catch-up.
outcome.zu: Uyabhalisa, kodwa kamuva uthola ukuthi esinye isifundo asiyona ingxenye yohlelo lwakho. Ukusishintsha kukulahlekisela ngesonto lokufunda.

lesson.en: Module mistakes are common and fixable, especially if caught early.
lesson.zu: Amaphutha ezifundo ajwayelekile futhi ayalungiseka, ikakhulukazi uma etholakala kusenesikhathi.

outcome.en: The advisor checks your curriculum in ten minutes and signs you up for a first-year mentor.
outcome.zu: Umeluleki uhlola uhlelo lwakho lwezifundo emizuzwini eyishumi futhi akubhalise kumeluleki wonyaka wokuqala.

lesson.en: Advisors exist for exactly this. Booking one early saves weeks.
lesson.zu: Abeluleki bakhona ngenxa yalokhu. Ukubhukha kusenesikhathi konga amasonto.

text.en: Campus is full of stalls. A sports team is recruiting, your friends are signing a gym deal ("only R300 a month, by debit order"), and there are dozens of societies you've never heard of.
text.zu: Ikhampasi igcwele amatafula. Iqembu lezemidlalo lifuna amalungu, abangane bakho basayina isivumelwano sejimu ("u-R300 kuphela ngenyanga, nge-debit order"), futhi kunezinhlangano eziningi ongakaze uzizwe.

label.en: Join a sports team or society

outcome.en: You pay a small membership fee and meet people at the first practice. Your week has a new anchor.
outcome.zu: Ukhokha imali encane yobulungu futhi uhlangana nabantu emzilolongweni wokuqala. Isonto lakho linento entsha elibambayo.

lesson.en: Clubs and societies are one of the cheapest ways to make friends and feel at home.
lesson.zu: Amaqembu nezinhlangano kungenye yezindlela ezishibhile zokuthola abangane nokuzizwa usekhaya.

label.en: Sign the gym contract with friends

outcome.en: Training with friends feels great. R300 now leaves your account every month, whether you go or not.
outcome.zu: Ukuzivocavoca nabangane kumnandi. U-R300 manje uphuma ku-akhawunti yakho nyanga zonke, noma uya noma ungayi.

lesson.en: Debit orders are easy to sign and hard to stop. Add them up before you commit.
lesson.zu: Ama-debit order kulula ukuwasayina futhi kunzima ukuwamisa. Wahlanganise ngaphambi kokuzibophezela.

outcome.en: You head back to your room. It's quieter and cheaper, but you don't know many people yet.
outcome.zu: Ubuyela ekamelweni lakho. Kuthule futhi kushibhile, kodwa awukabazi abantu abaningi.

lesson.en: You don't have to join much. One group, even a small one, makes the semester less lonely.
lesson.zu: Akudingeki ujoyine okuningi. Iqembu elilodwa, ngisho elincane, lenza isemesta ingabi nesizungu.

outcome.en: You tell the stall you can't afford it. They point you to societies that are free to join, and you sign up for one.
outcome.zu: Utshela itafula ukuthi awukwazi ukukhokha. Bakukhombisa izinhlangano zamahhala, bese ubhalisela eyodwa.

lesson.en: Many societies are free. Ask before you assume you can't join.
lesson.zu: Izinhlangano eziningi zimahhala. Buza ngaphambi kokucabanga ukuthi awukwazi ukujoyina.

events.research: Understanding Students Issue 2: cost stops many students joining

text.en: It's week three. NSFAS allowances for your group still haven't been paid and you have {money} left. Food is running out.
text.zu: Isonto lesithathu. Imali ye-NSFAS yeqembu lakho isengakakhokhwa futhi usele no-{money}. Ukudla kuyaphela.

outcome.en: You eat this week. You'll pay your friend back when the allowance lands.
outcome.zu: Uyadla kuleli sonto. Uzobuyisela imali kumngane wakho uma imali ifika.

lesson.en: Borrowing works short-term. Write down who you owe and repay on payday.
lesson.zu: Ukuboleka kusebenza okwesikhashana. Bhala phansi ukuthi ukweleta bani bese ubuyisela ngosuku lokuholela.

label.en: Skip meals and make it stretch

outcome.en: You get by on bread and tea. It's hard to concentrate in lectures.
outcome.zu: Uphila ngesinkwa netiye. Kunzima ukugxila ezifundweni.

lesson.en: Hunger hits your marks too. Food support exists so you don't have to do this.
lesson.zu: Indlala ithinta namamaki akho. Usizo lokudla lukhona ukuze ungakwenzi lokhu.

label.en: Skipping meals caught up with you

outcome.en: Campus food support gives you a food parcel and vouchers, and the SRC helps you check your NSFAS status.
outcome.zu: Usizo lokudla lwasekhampasi lukunika iphasela lokudla namavawusha, kanti i-SRC ikusiza uhlole isimo sakho se-NSFAS.

lesson.en: Go to food support early, before you run out, not after.
lesson.zu: Yiya osizweni lokudla kusenesikhathi, ngaphambi kokuthi kuphele, hhayi emva kwalokho.

events.research: Understanding Students Issue 2 (USAf 2018): food insecurity, dropout reasons

text.en: It's week three. Your bursary stipend still hasn't been paid and you have {money} left. Food is running out.
text.zu: Isonto lesithathu. Imali yomxhaso wakho isengakakhokhwa futhi usele no-{money}. Ukudla kuyaphela.

title.en: The money from home is late

text.en: It's week three. The money from home hasn't come yet this month and you have {money} left. Food is running out.
text.zu: Isonto lesithathu. Imali evela ekhaya ayikafiki kule nyanga futhi usele no-{money}. Ukudla kuyaphela.

text.en: It's week three. Your first pay or loan payment still hasn't come through and you have {money} left. Food is running out.
text.zu: Isonto lesithathu. Iholo lakho lokuqala noma inkokhelo yemalimboleko ayikangeni futhi usele no-{money}. Ukudla kuyaphela.

text.en: Someone at home calls. The electricity has run out and they need {amount} until month-end. You have {money}.
text.zu: Othile wasekhaya uyafona. Ugesi uphelile futhi badinga u-{amount} kuze kube sekupheleni kwenyanga. Uno-{money}.

outcome.en: Home is grateful. Your own month gets tight: food for the last week is uncertain.
outcome.zu: Ekhaya bayabonga. Inyanga yakho iba nzima: ukudla kwesonto lokugcina akuqinisekile.

lesson.en: Helping home matters. Budgeting for it upfront makes it sustainable.
lesson.zu: Ukusiza ekhaya kubalulekile. Ukukwenzela ibhajethi kusenesikhathi kukwenza kuqhubeke.

outcome.en: You send {half} and explain what you can manage. It helps, and you still eat.
outcome.zu: Uthumela u-{half} futhi uchaza ukuthi ungakwazi malini. Kuyasiza, futhi usadla.

lesson.en: Sending part and being clear about your limits is a real option.
lesson.zu: Ukuthumela ingxenye nokucacisa imikhawulo yakho kuyindlela yangempela.

outcome.en: It's a hard conversation. They understand more than you expected, and you agree to plan together next month.
outcome.zu: Kuyingxoxo enzima. Bayaqonda ngaphezu kwalokho obukulindele, futhi nivumelana ukuhlela ndawonye ngenyanga ezayo.

lesson.en: Saying "not this month" is allowed. Planning together beats guessing.
lesson.zu: Ukuthi "hhayi kule nyanga" kuvumelekile. Ukuhlela ndawonye kungcono kunokuqagela.

adaptive.en: Home asked for money because you said your family may need support.
adaptive.zu: Ekhaya bacele imali ngoba uthe umndeni wakho ungadinga ukusekelwa.

text.en: It's Wednesday night, your {mod1} quiz closes at midnight, and your data has just run out. A 1 GB bundle costs R149. You have {money}.
text.zu: NgoLwesithathu ebusuku, isivivinyo sakho se-{mod1} sivala phakathi kwamabili, futhi idatha yakho isanda kuphela. I-bundle ye-1 GB ibiza u-R149. Uno-{money}.

outcome.en: You finish the quiz. Data is now one of your biggest weekly costs.
outcome.zu: Uqeda isivivinyo. Idatha manje ingenye yezindleko zakho ezinkulu zamasonto onke.

lesson.en: Data adds up fast. Know where free Wi-Fi is before you need it.
lesson.zu: Idatha iyanqwabelana ngokushesha. Yazi ukuthi i-Wi-Fi yamahhala ikuphi ngaphambi kokuthi uyidinge.

label.en: Ask a friend to share a hotspot

outcome.en: Your friend shares data and you submit with two minutes to spare.
outcome.zu: Umngane wakho wabelana ngedatha futhi uhambisa kusele imizuzu emibili.

lesson.en: Friends help. A plan for data helps more.
lesson.zu: Abangane bayasiza. Uhlelo lwedatha lusiza nakakhulu.

label.en: Go to a campus computer lab or Wi-Fi spot
label.zu: Yiya egunjini lamakhompyutha noma endaweni ye-Wi-Fi ekhampasi

outcome.en: A lab is open late. You finish the quiz and learn that campus Wi-Fi is free for students.
outcome.zu: Igumbi lamakhompyutha livulekile kuze kube sebusuku. Uqeda isivivinyo futhi ufunda ukuthi i-Wi-Fi yasekhampasi imahhala kubafundi.

lesson.en: Campus Wi-Fi and computer labs can save you hundreds a month on data.
lesson.zu: I-Wi-Fi yasekhampasi namagumbi amakhompyutha angakongela amakhulu ngenyanga kudatha.

title.en: {mod1} test and {mod2} assignment in the same week
title.zu: Isivivinyo se-{mod1} nomsebenzi we-{mod2} ngesonto elilodwa

text.en: Your {mod1} test is on Thursday and the {mod2} assignment is due Friday. The prescribed {mod1} textbook costs R1 200, which you can't afford.
text.zu: Isivivinyo sakho se-{mod1} singoLwesine kanti umsebenzi we-{mod2} kufanele uhanjiswe ngoLwesihlanu. Incwadi emisiwe ye-{mod1} ibiza u-R1 200, ongakwazi ukuyikhokha.

textAppend.en: Without a laptop, you'll need a campus computer for the assignment.
textAppend.zu: Ngaphandle kwe-laptop, uzodinga ikhompyutha yasekhampasi ukwenza umsebenzi.

outcome.en: You hand in both, barely awake. The work is rushed.
outcome.zu: Uhambisa kokubili, ucishe ulale. Umsebenzi wenziwe ngokushesha.

lesson.en: All-nighters get things done but cost you later.
lesson.zu: Ukufunda ubusuku bonke kuyaqedela izinto kodwa kukulahlekisela kamuva.

outcome.en: Without a laptop you can't work through the night at home. You type the assignment on your phone and it shows.
outcome.zu: Ngaphandle kwe-laptop awukwazi ukusebenza ubusuku bonke ekhaya. Uthayipha umsebenzi ocingweni futhi kuyabonakala.

label.en: Drop the assignment, focus on the test

outcome.en: The test goes okay. The zero for {mod2} will hurt your semester mark.
outcome.zu: Isivivinyo sihamba kahle. Uziro we-{mod2} uzolimaza amamaki akho esemesta.

lesson.en: A missed assignment is a hole that's hard to climb out of.
lesson.zu: Umsebenzi ongenziwanga uyimbobo okunzima ukuphuma kuyo.

outcome.en: An academic coach helps you split the week into blocks. You finish both, and sleep.
outcome.zu: Umqeqeshi wezemfundo ukusiza uhlukanise isonto libe yizingxenye. Uqedela kokubili, futhi ulala.

lesson.en: Clashing deadlines are predictable. A coach helps you plan before they hit.
lesson.zu: Izinsuku zokuhambisa ezingqubuzanayo ziyabikezelwa. Umqeqeshi ukusiza uhlele ngaphambi kokuthi zifike.

outcome.en: A coach helps you plan the week around computer-lab hours. You finish both, and sleep.
outcome.zu: Umqeqeshi ukusiza uhlele isonto ngokuya ngamahora egumbi lamakhompyutha. Uqedela kokubili, futhi ulala.

outcome.en: A classmate shares their copy, and the library has two on short-loan. You get through the test topics.
outcome.zu: Ofunda naye wabelana ngekhophi yakhe, futhi umtapo unamabili okuboleka okwesikhashana. Udlula ezihlokweni zesivivinyo.

lesson.en: You don't have to buy every book. Share, borrow and use the library.
lesson.zu: Akudingeki uthenge zonke izincwadi. Yabelana, uboleke futhi usebenzise umtapo.

events.research: Understanding Students Issue 2: many skip materials due to cost

title.en: Lonely, can't sleep, thinking of going home
title.zu: Unesizungu, awukwazi ukulala, ucabanga ukubuyela ekhaya

text.en: Everyone else seems to have found their people. You lie awake missing home, and you've started looking at bus tickets. This is one of the most common feelings in first year, and it does pass with support.
text.zu: Wonke umuntu ubonakala ethole abantu bakhe. Ulala uphapheme ukhumbula ikhaya, futhi usuqalile ukubheka amathikithi ebhasi. Lona ngomunye wemizwa evame kakhulu onyakeni wokuqala, futhi uyedlula uma unosizo.

outcome.en: You keep going, but the nights are long. It's okay to ask for help at any point.
outcome.zu: Uyaqhubeka, kodwa ubusuku bude. Kulungile ukucela usizo noma nini.

lesson.en: Homesickness is easier with people around you.
lesson.zu: Ukukhumbula ikhaya kulula uma unabantu eduze kwakho.

outcome.en: Familiar voices help. Your family tells you they're proud of you, and you sleep a little better.
outcome.zu: Amazwi ajwayelekile ayasiza. Umndeni wakho ukutshela ukuthi uyaziqhenya ngawe, futhi ulala kangcono kancane.

lesson.en: Home is support too. On campus, a mentor or society can add to it.
lesson.zu: Ikhaya nalo liwusizo. Ekhampasi, umeluleki noma inhlangano kungengeza kulo.

label.en: Reach out: counselling, a mentor or a society

outcome.en: A counsellor helps with sleep and homesickness, and a mentor invites you to a society meetup that week.
outcome.zu: Umeluleki ukusiza ngokulala nokukhumbula ikhaya, futhi umeluleki wontanga ukumema emhlanganweni wenhlangano ngalelo sonto.

lesson.en: Feeling lonely in first year is common, and support is free.
lesson.zu: Ukuba nesizungu onyakeni wokuqala kuvamile, futhi usizo lumahhala.

adaptive.en: You met the loneliness card in week 6 because you joined nothing on Societies Day.
adaptive.zu: Uhlangabezane nekhadi lesizungu ngesonto lesi-6 ngoba awujoyinanga lutho ngoSuku Lwezinhlangano.

title.en: You can't sleep, and you're thinking of quitting

text.en: Everything feels heavy. You lie awake going over money and marks, and you've started wondering whether university is for you. Lots of first-years feel this way, and it does pass with support.
text.zu: Konke kuzwakala kusinda. Ulala uphapheme ucabanga ngemali namamaki, futhi usuqalile ukuzibuza ukuthi inyuvesi ingeyakho yini. Abafundi abaningi bonyaka wokuqala bazizwa kanjena, futhi kuyedlula uma unosizo.

outcome.en: You keep going, but you're running on empty. It's okay to ask for help at any point.
outcome.zu: Uyaqhubeka, kodwa amandla aphelile. Kulungile ukucela usizo noma nini.

lesson.en: Pushing through alone is harder than it needs to be.
lesson.zu: Ukuqhubeka wedwa kunzima kunalokho okudingekayo.

outcome.en: Your friend admits they feel the same. Just saying it out loud helps.
outcome.zu: Umngane wakho uyavuma ukuthi uzizwa ngendlela efanayo. Ukusho nje ngokuzwakalayo kuyasiza.

lesson.en: You're not the only one. Friends help, and counsellors can help more.
lesson.zu: Akusiwe wedwa. Abangane bayasiza, futhi abeluleki bangasiza nakakhulu.

outcome.en: A counsellor sees you that week. It's free and confidential, and you leave with a plan for sleep and stress.
outcome.zu: Umeluleki ukubona kuleli sonto. Kumahhala futhi kuyimfihlo, futhi uhamba nohlelo lokulala nokucindezeleka.

lesson.en: Counselling is free, confidential and for exactly this.
lesson.zu: Ukwelulekwa kumahhala, kuyimfihlo futhi kwenzelwe lokhu ngqo.

title.en: "Cheap room near campus, pay the deposit today"
title.zu: "Ikamelo elishibhile eduze nekhampasi, khokha idiphozithi namuhla"

text.en: Your room costs more than you planned, so you've been looking for something cheaper. A Facebook post offers a room in {area}, five minutes from campus, for half the usual price. The "landlord" says three others are interested: pay R1 500 today to secure it.
text.zu: Ikamelo lakho libiza ngaphezu kwalokho obukuhlelile, ngakho ubulokhu ufuna elishibhile. Okuthunyelwe ku-Facebook kunikeza ikamelo e-{area}, imizuzu emihlanu ukusuka ekhampasi, ngengxenye yentengo ejwayelekile. "Umnikazi" uthi abanye abathathu bayalifuna: khokha u-R1 500 namuhla ukuze ulithole.

outcome.en: The number stops answering. The room never existed. This happens to students every year, and it's not your fault.
outcome.zu: Inombolo ayisaphendula. Ikamelo alikaze libe khona. Lokhu kwenzeka kubafundi minyaka yonke, futhi akulona iphutha lakho.

lesson.en: Never pay a deposit for a room you haven't seen, with a lease you haven't signed.
lesson.zu: Ungalokothi ukhokhe idiphozithi yekamelo ongakaliboni, nenkontileka ongakayisayini.

outcome.en: The "landlord" makes excuses and can't show you the room. You walk away. Good instinct.
outcome.zu: "Umnikazi" wenza izaba futhi akakwazi ukukukhombisa ikamelo. Uyahamba. Umqondo omuhle.

lesson.en: A real landlord will always let you view the room.
lesson.zu: Umnikazi wangempela uyohlala ekuvumela ukubona ikamelo.

outcome.en: It's not on {short}'s accredited list, and the same photos appear on a listing in another city. You report the post.
outcome.zu: Alikho ohlwini lwe-{short} olugunyaziwe, futhi izithombe ezifanayo zivela kokukhangiswa kwelinye idolobha. Ubika okuthunyelwe.

lesson.en: Check accreditation and search the photos before paying anything.
lesson.zu: Hlola ukugunyazwa futhi useshe izithombe ngaphambi kokukhokha noma yini.

text.en: Taxi fares on your route went up, and with traffic you spend four hours a day travelling. You missed the start of a {mod1} tutorial again.
text.zu: Imali yetekisi emzileni wakho inyukile, futhi ngenxa yethrafikhi uchitha amahora amane ngosuku ugibela. Uphinde waphuthelwa ukuqala kwethuthorial ye-{mod1}.

outcome.en: You're exhausted by Thursday and the late starts keep adding up.
outcome.zu: Ukhathele ngoLwesine futhi ukufika sekwephuzile kuyaqhubeka kunqwabelana.

lesson.en: Commuting time is study time lost. Plan around it.
lesson.zu: Isikhathi sokugibela yisikhathi sokufunda esilahlekile. Hlela ngakho.

label.en: Study on campus, travel after peak
label.zu: Funda ekhampasi, ugibele emva kwesikhathi sokuminyana

outcome.en: You study in the library until the rush is over, and travel back with classmates.
outcome.zu: Ufunda emtapweni kuze kuphele ukuminyana, bese ubuya nabafunda nabo.

lesson.en: Use campus time well and travel with others for safety.
lesson.zu: Sebenzisa kahle isikhathi sasekhampasi futhi ugibele nabanye ukuze uphephe.

outcome.en: You find the support set up for commuting students, with study space and a community on campus.
outcome.zu: Uthola usizo olwenzelwe abafundi abagibelayo, olunendawo yokufunda nomphakathi ekhampasi.

lesson.en: Commuting students have support too. Find your people on campus.
lesson.zu: Abafundi abagibelayo nabo banosizo. Thola abantu bakho ekhampasi.

title.en: The gym debit order you forgot about

text.en: You haven't been to the gym in three weeks. The R300 still left your account this month.
text.zu: Awukayi ejimini emasontweni amathathu. U-R300 usaphume ku-akhawunti yakho kule nyanga.

label.en: Keep paying, you'll go next week

outcome.en: Next week becomes the week after.
outcome.zu: Isonto elizayo liba yisonto elilandela lelo.

outcome.en: There's a one-month notice fee, then the debit order stops for good.
outcome.zu: Kunemali yesaziso yenyanga eyodwa, bese i-debit order iyama unomphela.

outcome.en: Three mornings a week with friends. Now it's worth the money.
outcome.zu: Izikhathi ezintathu zasekuseni ngesonto nabangane. Manje kufanele imali.

adaptive.en: The gym debit order came back because you signed the contract on Societies Day.
adaptive.zu: I-debit order yejimu ibuyile ngoba usayine isivumelwano ngoSuku Lwezinhlangano.

text.en: Your phone is snatched on the walk back from campus. Your timetable, group chats and banking app were all on it. You have {money}.
text.zu: Ifoni yakho iphucwa usendleleni ubuya ekhampasi. Uhlelo lwakho lwezifundo, amaqembu okuxoxa ne-app yasebhange konke bekukuyo. Uno-{money}.

outcome.en: You're back online in a day, but R800 is gone.
outcome.zu: Ubuyela ku-inthanethi ngosuku olulodwa, kodwa u-R800 uhambile.

lesson.en: Surprise costs hit everyone. A small buffer turns them into an inconvenience, not a crisis.
lesson.zu: Izindleko ezingalindelekile zithinta wonke umuntu. Imali encane eyisiphephelo iziguqula zibe yinkinga encane, hhayi inhlekelele.

label.en: Use an old phone from family

outcome.en: An old phone arrives by taxi parcel after a week. You missed some group-chat messages about a test.
outcome.zu: Ifoni endala ifika ngephasela letekisi emva kwesonto. Uphuthelwe imilayezo ethile yeqembu mayelana nesivivinyo.

lesson.en: Going without a phone for a week costs more than you'd think.
lesson.zu: Ukuhlala ngaphandle kwefoni isonto kubiza ngaphezu kwalokho ongakucabanga.

outcome.en: You report it to campus security, use campus computers for a few days, and find a second-hand phone for R300.
outcome.zu: Ukubika kwezokuphepha ekhampasi, usebenzisa amakhompyutha asekhampasi izinsuku ezimbalwa, bese uthola ifoni esetshenzisiwe ngo-R300.

lesson.en: Report theft, and lean on campus computers while you sort out a phone.
lesson.zu: Bika ukwebiwa, futhi uthembele kumakhompyutha asekhampasi ngenkathi ulungisa udaba lwefoni.

title.en: Surprise: you need a lab coat by Monday

text.en: Your first {mod1} practical is on Monday. A lab coat and safety glasses are compulsory: R350 at the campus shop. You have {money}.
text.zu: Isifundo sakho sokuqala se-{mod1} esenziwayo singoMsombuluko. Ijazi lelabhu nezibuko zokuphepha kuyaphoqelelwa: u-R350 esitolo sasekhampasi. Uno-{money}.

outcome.en: You're kitted out, and R350 lighter.
outcome.zu: Usuhlomile, futhi u-R350 ungasekho.

lesson.en: Compulsory kit is a predictable surprise. Ask seniors what your course needs before term.
lesson.zu: Izinto eziphoqelelwe ziyisimanga esibikezelwayo. Buza abafundi abadala ukuthi isifundo sakho sidingani ngaphambi kwetemu.

outcome.en: A third-year sells you their old coat for R150 and tells you which practicals are hardest.
outcome.zu: Umfundi wonyaka wesithathu ukuthengisela ijazi lakhe elidala ngo-R150 futhi akutshele ukuthi yiziphi izifundo ezenziwayo ezinzima kakhulu.

lesson.en: Seniors are a great source of second-hand kit, and advice.
lesson.zu: Abafundi abadala bawumthombo omuhle wezinto ezisetshenzisiwe, nezeluleko.

outcome.en: You save the money, but practical marks count towards your semester mark.
outcome.zu: Uyayonga imali, kodwa amamaki ezifundo ezenziwayo abalwa emamakini esemesta.

lesson.en: Missing practicals is an expensive way to save money.
lesson.zu: Ukweqa izifundo ezenziwayo kuyindlela ebizayo yokonga imali.

text.en: Your {mod1} lecturer wants printed course packs and a printed assignment by Friday: about R300 in total. You have {money}.
text.zu: Umfundisi wakho we-{mod1} ufuna amaphakethe ezifundo aphrintiwe nomsebenzi ophrintiwe ngoLwesihlanu: cishe u-R300 sekukonke. Uno-{money}.

outcome.en: Done, and R300 gone.
outcome.zu: Kwenziwe, futhi u-R300 uhambile.

lesson.en: Printing and course packs are a real cost. Put them in your budget.
lesson.zu: Ukuphrinta namaphakethe ezifundo kuyizindleko zangempela. Kufake ebhajethini yakho.

label.en: Share a course pack with a classmate

outcome.en: You split the cost and start studying together.
outcome.zu: Nihlukanisa izindleko futhi niqala ukufunda ndawonye.

lesson.en: Sharing costs with classmates halves them, and builds a study group.
lesson.zu: Ukwabelana ngezindleko nabafunda nabo kuzinciphisa ngesigamu, futhi kwakha iqembu lokufunda.

label.en: Use library copies and student printing

outcome.en: The library has the course pack on short-loan, and student printing is cheap.
outcome.zu: Umtapo unephakethe lesifundo lokuboleka okwesikhashana, futhi ukuphrinta kwabafundi kushibhile.

lesson.en: The library is the cheapest place to start.
lesson.zu: Umtapo yindawo eshibhile kakhulu yokuqala.

text.en: Your laptop won't turn on, two days before a deadline. The repair quote is R900. You have {money}.
text.zu: I-laptop yakho ayivuli, ezinsukwini ezimbili ngaphambi komnqamulajuqu. Intengo yokulungisa ingu-R900. Uno-{money}.

outcome.en: It's back in three days. R900 gone.
outcome.zu: Ibuya ezinsukwini ezintathu. U-R900 uhambile.

label.en: Use the computer labs for now

outcome.en: A cheaper repair shop and a week in the labs. You meet the lab regulars.
outcome.zu: Isitolo sokulungisa esishibhile nesonto emagumbini amakhompyutha. Uhlangana nabahlala lapho.

outcome.en: Campus IT runs a basic check and points you to a student-priced repair.
outcome.zu: I-IT yasekhampasi yenza ukuhlola okuyisisekelo futhi ikukhombise ukulungiswa ngentengo yabafundi.

text.en: A fever that won't go away. A private GP visit costs about R550. You have {money}.
text.zu: Imfiva engapheli. Ukuvakashela udokotela ozimele kubiza cishe u-R550. Uno-{money}.

outcome.en: Antibiotics and a sick note. R550 gone.
outcome.zu: Ama-antibiotic nencwadi yokugula. U-R550 uhambile.

outcome.en: Campus health sees you the same day for almost nothing.
outcome.zu: Umtholampilo wasekhampasi ukubona ngalolo suku ngemali encane kakhulu.

outcome.en: It takes a week to pass. You miss two lectures.
outcome.zu: Kuthatha isonto ukudlula. Uphuthelwa yizifundo ezimbili.

title.en: Your friend needs their money back

text.en: The friend who lent you R300 says their own money is tight now. You have {money}.
text.zu: Umngane okuboleke u-R300 uthi imali yakhe manje ishoda. Uno-{money}.

outcome.en: Square again. The friendship feels lighter.
outcome.zu: Senilingana futhi. Ubungane buzwakala bulula.

outcome.en: They agree to month-end. You put a reminder in your phone.
outcome.zu: Bayavuma ekupheleni kwenyanga. Ufaka isikhumbuzo efonini yakho.

outcome.en: You take the long way round to avoid them. The debt and the awkwardness both grow.
outcome.zu: Uhamba indlela ende ukuze ubagweme. Isikweletu nokungakhululeki kuyakhula kokubili.

adaptive.en: Your friend asked for their money back because you borrowed in week 3.
adaptive.zu: Umngane wakho ucele imali yakhe ngoba uboleke ngesonto lesi-3.

text.en: You've watched one series this month, but about R100 still leaves your account every month for streaming. That's about R1 200 a year.
text.zu: Ubuke uchungechunge olulodwa kule nyanga, kodwa cishe u-R100 usaphuma ku-akhawunti yakho nyanga zonke ngokubuka. Lokho kucishe kube ngu-R1 200 ngonyaka.

label.en: Keep it: it's my one treat

outcome.en: That's a fair choice, as long as it's in your budget on purpose.
outcome.zu: Lokho kuyisinqumo esifanele, uma nje kusebhajethini yakho ngamabomu.

lesson.en: Treats belong in a budget too. Just know what they cost over a year.
lesson.zu: Izinto zokuzijabulisa nazo zingena ebhajethini. Yazi nje ukuthi zibiza malini ngonyaka.

outcome.en: Two taps and it's gone. That money stays in your account now.
outcome.zu: Ukuthepha kabili bese kuphela. Leyo mali manje ihlala ku-akhawunti yakho.

lesson.en: Once a month, check your bank statement for debit orders you forgot about.
lesson.zu: Kanye ngenyanga, hlola isitatimende sakho sasebhange ukuthola ama-debit order owakhohlwa.

label.en: Split an account with a friend

outcome.en: Your friend adds you to their plan, and you split the cost.
outcome.zu: Umngane wakho ukufaka ohlelweni lwakhe, futhi nihlukanisa izindleko.

lesson.en: Where a service allows it, sharing a plan halves the cost.
lesson.zu: Lapho isevisi ikuvumela, ukwabelana ngohlelo kunciphisa izindleko ngesigamu.
